answer: To resist sybils, each voting agent posts a refundable bond and must tend a unique garden of sequential, key-bound work receipts that no other identity can continue. Withdrawal of the bond waits through a long tundra of idle epochs, so abandoned fakes stay expensive. A colliding claimant is treated as a dune collapse: the copy is rejected and its stake burned. Because every fake needs its own capital, delay, and exclusive receipt stream, a swarm cannot be cloned from one script.
